text: 3. It effectes in the air, and is flowed converted into fulphate of magenae. It is foluble in 20 parts of cold water. Boiling water didtics a greater proportion, and from this fit crystallizes on cooling. Exposed to heat, this felt becomes vicidé, and by calcination it lofea 0.4; of its weight. If the heat be increased, it is decomposed, the acid is driven off, and the pure earth remains behind.
